summary_en: LLC VIC (80% Itochu, 20% IFP) to launch public tender offer for all outstanding Dentsu Soken shares with board recommendation to accept. Tender expected to commence early Nov 2026, subject to completion of antitrust clearances in Japan, China, and EU (all targeted for completion by Nov 2026). Post-tender, VIC and Dentsu Group to hold 38.22% and 61.78% of voting shares respectively; delisting expected. Special committee established to reaffirm fairness assessment at launch.
title_en: Notice of Board Endorsement and Recommendation regarding Anticipated Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by LLC VIC
translation_en_brief: On 28 August 2026, Dentsu Soken's board of directors resolved to express support for and recommend to shareholders a forthcoming public tender offer by LLC VIC (a limited liability company 80% owned by Itochu Corporation and 20% owned by IFP Inc.) for all outstanding ordinary shares of Dentsu Soken. The offer is intended to make Dentsu Soken wholly owned by VIC and Dentsu Group (which will hold 38.22% and 61.78% of voting shares respectively post-tender), with subsequent delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. VIC aims to commence the tender offer in early November 2026, contingent on obtaining antitrust clearances in Japan, China, and the EU, each expected to take approximately 25–30 days from filing. The company has established a special committee to reaffirm the fairness of the transaction and will re-confirm its recommendation upon actual launch of the offer. Specific terms of the tender (share count, price, period duration) are not yet disclosed.
